title: Treating Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) With R(+) Pramipexole Dihydrochloride Monohydrate at 60 mg/Day
brief_summary: R(+) pramipexole dihydrochloride monohydrate \[R(+)PPX\], an experimental neuroprotective drug, is provided in this open label extension study to ALS patients who have participated in earlier clinical protocols.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Definite diagnosis of ALS

Exclusion Criteria:

* No prior participation in R(+)PPX clinical studies
